name: ESIC (Employees' State Insurance)
description: Social security and health insurance scheme for workers in covered establishments (medical, sickness, maternity, disability benefits).
eligibility: Employees with wage up to Rs. 21,000/month (Rs. 25,000 for persons with disability) in ESIC-covered factories/establishments.
benefits: Cashless medical care for worker and family, sickness/maternity benefits, disability and dependent benefits.
application_steps: Employer registers establishment and enrols employees (Form 1).
Avail treatment at ESIC dispensary/hospital with card.
